name: actera

mode.title: Actera mode
mode.description: Monitoring records policy results without blocking. Enforcing blocks denied actions and holds calls that need approval.

evaluation_failure.title: When Actera cannot evaluate
evaluation_failure.description: Applies only in Enforcing mode: choose what happens on service outages, timeouts, invalid responses or input-scanning failures. Explicit denials and required approvals remain enforced. Monitoring always continues.

description: Monitor and enforce tool decisions with execution reports in Actera
